question: I want to see new contacts from the last 30 days.

question: List all intended parents with case name, name, email, email confirmation status, and last portal login.
gold_sql:
SELECT * FROM (SELECT
  ip_case.case_id,
  COALESCE(ip_case.case_file_name, CONCAT('Case ', ip_case.case_id)) AS case_name,
  CONCAT(c1.first_name, ' ', c1.last_name) AS full_name,
  c1.email,
  CASE WHEN contact_lead.contact_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Confirmed' ELSE 'Not Confirmed' END AS email_confirmation_status,
  contact_lead.last_login AS last_portal_login
FROM ip_case
INNER JOIN family ON ip_case.family_id = family.family_id
LEFT JOIN contact c1 ON family.ip_1_id = c1.contact_id
LEFT JOIN contact_lead ON c1.contact_id = contact_lead.contact_id
WHERE c1.contact_type = 'IP'
  AND c1.spam = 0
  AND c1.dq = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT
  ip_case.case_id,
  COALESCE(ip_case.case_file_name, CONCAT('Case ', ip_case.case_id)) AS case_name,
  CONCAT(c2.first_name, ' ', c2.last_name) AS full_name,
  c2.email,
  CASE WHEN contact_lead.contact_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Confirmed' ELSE 'Not Confirmed' END AS email_confirmation_status,
  contact_lead.last_login AS last_portal_login
FROM ip_case
INNER JOIN family ON ip_case.family_id = family.family_id
LEFT JOIN contact c2 ON family.ip_2_id = c2.contact_id
LEFT JOIN contact_lead ON c2.contact_id = contact_lead.contact_id
WHERE c2.contact_type = 'IP'
  AND c2.spam = 0
  AND c2.dq = 0
  AND c2.contact_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY case_name, full_name
LIMIT 500) AS assistant_report
